# Folk

folk is a next-generation CRM designed for teams to manage and nurture their relationships efficiently.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/folk/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Create a new company in the workspace.
- **Delete Company**: Delete a company from the workspace (irreversible).
- **Delete Person**: Delete an existing person in the workspace (irreversible).
- **Get Company** (read-only): Retrieve an existing company by its id.
- **Get Current Workspace User** (read-only): Get details of the current authenticated workspace user.
- **Get Person** (read-only): Retrieve an existing person by their id.
- **List Companies** (read-only): List companies in the workspace.
- **List Groups** (read-only): List workspace groups.
- **List People** (read-only): List people in the workspace.
- **List Users** (read-only): List workspace users.
- **Update Company**: Update an existing company in the workspace.
- **List Group Custom Fields** (read-only): List custom fields for a specific group and entity type.
